prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache, soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre, natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines, childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel. No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the generated image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square hero illustration for Atlas of AI by Kate Crawford. Input image: the supplied spaced-review.webp is a style reference only; match its gouache medium, paper texture, muted colors and gentle light. Do not reproduce its people, study scene or panel composition. Create a new single coherent visual metaphor: an open, unlettered atlas rests on a warm ivory surface, its pages forming a miniature physical landscape. A small terraced ochre mineral quarry at the left, two modest charcoal server cabinets at the center, and a believable adult data worker seated at a simple terminal on the right occupy the same landscape. A thin brown cable quietly connects the elements across the pages. Keep these few forms large and legible, with a sage hillside in the background and generous quiet margins. The book is a map of hidden material and human dependencies, not a fake book cover. No graphs, icons, glowing brains, robots or numbers. This is an illustrative metaphor, not a literal historical event or a portrait. Balanced square composition, finished editorial illustration, at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
